unit_rules.name: Hive Commander
unit_rules.text: At the start of the Battle Round, if this model is on the battlefield, you gain 1 CP.

unit_rules.name: Domination of the Hive
unit_rules.text: While a friendly +Hunger+ unit is within 9" of this model, that unit is always considered to be within Hive Will range.

unit_rules.name: Malign Presence
unit_rules.text: If this model is your Warlord, each time your opponent targets a unit within 12" of this model with a Stratagem, increase that Stratagem's CP cost by 1.
